metadata.description: 6 interactive demonstration scenarios for Phone Sensor Simulator (accessible via QR code). Live 60-second telemetry streams matching Rule 1.3 schema.

normal_walk.name: Normal Surface Walk
normal_walk.description: Nominal EVA traverse on flat regolith (slope 2°-4°). Stable vitals, optimal muscle oxygenation (SmO2 78%), and nominal O2 consumption.

steep_climb.name: Steep Crater Climb (LRO LOLA +18°)
steep_climb.description: Ascending steep crater rim (+18° slope). Muscle SmO2 drops rapidly toward 42%, metabolic rate spikes to 510W, walk-back limit approached (04:52 warning).

fall_in_crater.name: Fall in Crater (Loss of Balance)
fall_in_crater.description: Astronaut slips on loose rim scree (fall=1). Automatically activates suit 100% O2 blast, emergency heating, and 30-second cancellation countdown on forearm cuff.

chest_pain.name: Acute Chest Pain (Suspected Ischemia)
chest_pain.description: Sudden crushing retrosternal chest pain. Significant ECG ST-elevation (+0.286 mV), cardiogenic hypotension (82/54 mmHg). AUTO-JUMPS to Mode 2. HARD-BLOCKS Nitroglycerin! Deploys AED protocol.

tired_says_fine.name: Tired, Says Fine (Masking Detected)
tired_says_fine.description: Astronaut underreports fatigue (energy slider 9.1/10) while biometric telemetry detects muscle exhaustion (SmO2 48%, gait tremor +2.3 SD). Triggers Mismatch Detected banner and revokes auto-clearance.

reset_all.name: Reset to Nominal Baseline
reset_all.description: Restores nominal resting state across all 4 crew members, resets alarms, clears emergency flags, and returns to baseline mission parameters.
